_comment: The 1 h DD-INTEGER arm (docs/HANDOFF_slant_triple_next.md §3) — posture C
(triple + free slant iono + GF datum) + the DD-fractional trace at stride 1,
so the ambiguity-integer question becomes askable against the fixture's known
true integers for the first time.
THE 1 h RULE (handoff §2) applies to every number from this arm: rank/datum/
wiring/integer-structure questions are LEGAL; variance factors, levels, the
exchange coefficient and consumer verdicts are NOT — quote them only from the
480-epoch settled matrix (SPEC §13.5).
PRE-REGISTERED (handoff §3.3, restated before the run):
pessimistic — slant frees the per-LOS iono further; per-band NL-class DDs
stay non-integer (med|frac| ~ 0.25 uniform).
optimistic — at f=3 the (L2,L5) EWL (λ 5.86 m) is iono-immune; the cascade
EWL → WL → NL becomes measurable.  Expected shape: EWL near-integer, WL
plausible, NL not — the value is WHICH RUNG BREAKS.
Arithmetic behind the shape, in cycle-difference form (e_lane = e_b − e_b'):
iono sensitivity per metre of L1 DD-iono error: L1 5.26 cyc, WL(1,2) 1.49,
EWL(2,5) 0.29 — an 18x ladder between NL and EWL.
Knob names verified against the loader: trace_dd_fractional_epoch_stride (the
handoff wrote _stride), trace_dd_fractional_max_pairs.  max_pairs 2000 keeps
the file bounded (~2000 rows x 120 epochs); the subsample is deterministic
per (week,tow), so truth matching is unaffected.
Exe: gnss_processor_matrix.exe sha256 DA2F9AC0… (the §13.5 matrix snapshot).
